titulo: Link the category from the staff positions list
ayuda_boton: Help on the category from the staff positions list
ayuda: Check that the category in the analysis matches the requested position. If it does but has not yet been published, ask the catalogue manager to publish it, then select Refresh. Next, select Link this category to prepare the appointment in Personnel. If the category is incorrect, you can amend the analysis before deciding how to fill the vacancy. If that decision has already been made or the case has been assigned, notify the person responsible for the case and wait until the correction has been resolved. Do not link an incorrect category.
cargando: Checking the category of the case…
categoria_analisis: Category set by the HR analysis
origen: This category comes from the HR analysis and cannot be changed here.
aviso_vincular: Check that the category matches the position. If it does not, do not link it; correct it in the analysis step of this case.
vinculada_texto: You can now prepare the onboarding in Personnel, below.
cambio_analisis: The linked category ({anterior}) no longer matches the analysis. Link the current category.
no_publicada: The category in the analysis has not been published yet, so it cannot be linked. If it is correct, ask the person who manages the category catalogue to publish it. If it is incorrect, correct it in the analysis step of this case; if it can no longer be changed, tell the person handling the case. Then select Refresh and link the category.
sin_publicadas: No categories have been published yet, so none can be linked. Ask the person who manages the category catalogue to publish it. Then select Refresh and link the category.
pendiente: The category cannot be linked yet because the HR analysis of this case is not confirmed. Confirm it in the analysis step of this case, then select Refresh.
denegada: You do not have permission to link the category of this case.
conflicto: The case or its analysis has changed. Select Refresh and check the category again.
rechazada: The link was not accepted. Select Refresh and try again. If it keeps happening, contact IT.
no_disponible: The category cannot be checked right now. Select Refresh. If it keeps happening, contact IT.
incierto: We could not confirm whether the link was recorded. Select Check the link before trying again.
